set.t: Two independent 1874 papers; a recovery was rumoured but never admitted. The letter put the well under half a mile N of the gravel road and about 8 paces from the N-S road; the correspondent paced 80 to the road and 155 to the half-mile stake, so the well lies beside the 27/28 road within about 120 m of the W quarter corner. Private farmland: ask permission.
